correctness.rationale: Explicit facetwise radial formulas plus dominated convergence yield the critical functional locally uniformly; cube-overlap comparison gives a global compact bound and hence Hausdorff convergence. An exact Jacobian transformation gives the Dirichlet volume identity. Strict finite bounds use t<sinh(t); the first asymptotic term follows from Dirichlet moment identities, with mean-squared remainders O(n^-2). The included standard-library diagnostic passed 1015 assertions but is not substituted for universal proof.
